reuse.why: Replaces the per-action category queries with one getMonthActionCategories helper that every month-wide action (including the new one and copyPreviousMonth) uses, and the new action reuses getSheetValue/setBudget/isTrackingBudget; the sign of the amount is still written inline rather than shared.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the category SQL; what remains repeated is the per-action income/tracking guard and an inline expense-sign expression in setLastMonthSpending that mirrors the `avg *= -1` in set3MonthAvg/setNMonthAvg.

placement.why: Selection rules (hidden, template, #fixed) live in one helper in budget/actions.ts beside the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the new method and its registration, and tests for the four requested behaviours.

maintainability.why: A new exclusion rule now has one home and the includeHiddenCategories option is a single named parameter; the income-only-in-tracking rule still sits at every call site and copyPreviousMonth combines its own loop data with an id-set filter, which a maintainer must remember.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) take their categories from getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline `cat.is_income === 1 ? net : 0 - net` in setLastMonthSpending restates the existing expense-sign rule in a different form, but it is a one-line expression, not a disguised block.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories in budget/actions.ts gained the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and one hiddenFilter ternary; no month-wide action bypasses it, though the income/tracking guard remains repeated at each call site outside the helper.
